full_judgment:
Mohammad Ali, J : In this application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the opposite party-State was called upon to show cause as to why the proceedings of Jatrabari Police Station Case No.33 dated 9-12-2012 corresponding to GR No. 1178 of 2018 under sections 143/147/148/149/186/332/333/ 353/427/109 of the Penal Code, 1860, now pending in the learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, 2nd Court, Dhaka should not be quashed and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. At the time of issuance of the Rule the proceedings of Jatrabari Police Station Case No.33 dated 9-12-2012 corresponding to GR No. 1178 of 2018 under section 143/147/148/149/ 186/332/333/353/427/109 of the Penal Code, so far it relates to the petitioner was stayed till disposal of the Rule. 

 3. Facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of the Rule, in short, are that the informant lodged an FIR on 9-12-2012 accusing 17 persons alongwith 40/50 unknown accuseds for the commission of the offence under section 143/147/148/149/186/332/333/353/427/ 109 of the Penal Code, alleging, inter-alia, that on that on the date of occurrence while countrywide blockade programe was going on, some 40/50 accused persons of eighteen parties alliance being emboldened by the speeches of the petitioner and others leaders of opposition political parties, damaged the vehicles and burned down those at the place of occurrence situated nearby Darul Ihsan University, Jatrabari, Dhaka, and at the time of occurrence the accused persons hurled brickbats pointing at the law enforcing agency causing injuries to them. Hence the case. 

 4. Police after investigation submitted charge-sheet on 28-2-2014 against 69 persons including the petitioner under section 143/147/ 148/149/186/332/333/353 of the Penal Code, 1860 (Annexure-C). 

 7. Mr. ASM Sazzad Haider, learned Senior Advocate appearing for the petitioner, at the very outset submits that the petitioner is the Secretary General of Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) and an eminent personality having good reputation and widely regarded with respect at home and abroad. He is not named in the FIR. Subsequently, his name has been falsely inserted in the proceeding at the behest of interested quarter only to harass, humiliate and lower down his prestige and position in the society. He next submits that insertion of his name in the police report in the manner is concocted and frivolous one. Neither prima facie case has been disclosed nor there is any ingredient of section 143/147/148/149/186/332/ 333/353/427/109 of the Penal Code, 1860 in as much as the case as well as the investigation report is a preposterous one which has been filed with intent to victimize the petitioner who is an elderly person having undisputed political credentials in national level. 

 9. In support of his contentions, learned Counsel referred the case of All Akkas vs Enayet Hossain and others reported in 1997 BLD (AD) 44 : 2 BLC (AD) 16 and the case of Abdul Quader Chowdhury and others vs State reported in 28 DLR (AD) 38. 

 16. In this regard, it may be profitable to quote the relevant paragraph from the celebrated case of Abdul Quader vs State reported in 28 DLR (AD) 38 wherein the Hon'ble Appellate Division observed that: 

 19. The principle as laid down in the 28 DLR case for quashing the proceeding has been reiterated in the case of Ali Akkas vs Enayet Hossain and others reported in 17 BLD (AD) 44. 

 27. The proceeding of Jatrabari Police Station Case No.33 dated 9-12-2012 corresponding to GR No. 1178 of 2018 under section 143/147/148/149/186/332/333/353/427/109 of the Penal Code, 1860, now pending in the learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, 2nd Court, Dhaka, so far it relates to the petitioner is hereby quashed. 28. The order of stay granted earlier by this court is hereby vacated.
